issue.title: Home-cards real-Obsidian runner fails 7 baseline checks (terminal ^prj Reading decoration, cursor start line, __catalog spawn classification, project _ fold timeout)
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-qi.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #6); triaged and reproduced by the bob-cli-qi land agent.

## What fails

The real-Obsidian Area/Project home-card runner `scripts/obsidian-home-cards-e2e.cjs` in bob-plugins passes 53 of 60 checks. The same 7 checks fail every time:

1. `card:scheduled_plan.md:reading`, `card:done_plan.md:reading`, `card:canceled_plan.md:reading`: in Reading mode, the `^prj` goal line of a scheduled, done, or canceled project is missing its goal decoration.
2. `matrix-spawns-no-home-card-bob`: two `bob __catalog --protocol 1` spawns are counted as home-card triggered. They come from Command Mode's catalog probe. `classifyBobInvocation` in `scripts/obsidian-home-cards-e2e-lib.cjs` marks any command it does not recognize as `homeCardTriggered: true`. All `ledger:*` spawns are classified correctly. This looks like a runner classification gap, not a real home-card spawn.
3. `area-cursor-starts-on-body-line` and `project-cursor-starts-on-body-line`: the cursor is drawn at the expected top, but `lineText` is not the expected body line. For the area it is `# Long Summary`, the H1 that the card hides.
4. `runner-error`: "Timed out waiting for project folds on _" on `root_plan.md` in Live Preview. The runner aborts before taking screenshots, so it keeps no area/project card visuals.

## Why this is baseline, not bob-cli-qi

The failure set is identical at bob-plugins b021aff5 (current master at triage) and at 27447919. 27447919 is the parent of 8e6a5a61, the first bob-cli-qi plugin commit, so it predates every bob-cli-qi change. qi.4 also saw the identical set at 4e0a8fd0, with and without its own fix. These are leftovers from the canceled bob-cli-pl area/project card work. Evidence: file:explicit:d254ed707483200bbaaca14f (homecards-master.json, homecards-pre.json, commands.md, receipts).

## Repro

    cd <bob-plugins checkout>
    OBSIDIAN_TASKS_PLUGIN_DIR=~/bob/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-tasks-plugin \
      xvfb-run -a node scripts/obsidian-home-cards-e2e.cjs \
      -e /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian -o /tmp/hc-shots -r /tmp/hc.json

The run takes about 45 seconds.

## Done when

All 60 checks pass, or each wrong expectation is corrected with a recorded reason. The run also produces and keeps the area/project screenshots. For each failure, decide whether the product or the runner expectation is wrong. Do not weaken ownership, cursor, or spawn assertions just to get green.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The identical 7-check failure set reproduced in every run: 2 qi.4 runs at 4e0a8fd0, 1 land run at b021aff5, and 1 land run at pre-epic 27447919. The runner-error timeout aborts at the same step each time.
